source: Yahoo Finance option chains via yfinance (delayed ~15 min)

timeseries.note: Incremental (locked-in) classification. Points marked rebuilt=1 were rebuilt by replaying git-committed snapshots, which only kept tape rows (top 60 contracts per ticker by premium); the catchup=1 point is the first full-chain incremental run, where the session volume of contracts never on the tape was classified once at that snapshot's quotes.

notes.inferred: Inferred net premium from live delayed snapshots (side inferred from last vs bid/ask); available from 2026-10-28.
notes.occ_cp: OCC cleared contract volume, calls vs puts, completed sessions only. No side, no premium.
